scope: Three complete CQL scan profiles and native PostgreSQL COUNT; five PG CPU captures unavailable after Fly SSH timeout.
limits: CPU widths are sample counts, not request elapsed time; inclusive frame percentages overlap.
Context-switch callchains are sampled every100events; widths are sampled event weights, not off-CPU durations or individual mutex waits.
Profiled rates are diagnostics; CPU and context-switch instrumentation add uncalibrated overhead.
Allocator CPU frames and RSS do not measure live allocation volume.
Counter windows use 1Hz samples fully inside recorded measurement bounds; CPU/I/O are observed lower bounds.
All monitored colocated processes are included; process totals are not engine-only CPU.
RSS is not allocation volume; wchan and context-switch callchains do not measure individual mutex wait durations.
Collector overhead is uncalibrated; live allocation volume and hardware cache-miss counters are unavailable.
Cassandra JIT frames are mostly module-only; zero unknown leaves does not mean full Java symbolization.
No completed Ferrosa PG CPU comparison from this cohort is claimed.
